cases.title: A paraphrase of the objective
cases.objective: 只读审查 knowledge-base 项目的 RAG 实现，优先复用已有审查结果并给出可验证的优化建议。
cases.summary: 对该项目的 RAG 实现做只读审查，并先复用已有审查结果。
cases.note: Known false negative: the exact-match rule deliberately keeps a paraphrase. If a later rule tightens and drops it, this baseline change forces review.

cases.title: A restatement of what the worker did
cases.objective: Read README.md and summarize the project in three sentences.
cases.note: Known false negative: the rule does not judge evidence text, only the task objective. The owner still reviews the candidate.

cases.title: The conversation job's placeholder objective
cases.note: Conversation mining uses this fixed objective; echoing it is not a memory either.

cases.title: A lesson from a failed run whose evidence only shows success
cases.objective: 只读任务：读取当前工作区根目录的 README.md，不要修改任何文件。然后在最终答复中原样包含这句话：以后所有报告默认使用简体中文。
cases.summary: 下次应先直接读取当前工作区根目录的 README.md，而不是列出 /Users/qihoo/.clone，并在最终答复中原样包含指定句子。
cases.note: The recorded 2026-11-19 memory. The directory listing records success, not the missing README; the lesson is a restatement of the task, not an observed cause.

cases.title: A lesson that cites the failing test evidence
cases.summary: 发布前先跑完整测试；这次跳过测试导致了一次回归。
evidence: npm test failed: 2 assertions in test/release.test.ts
cases.note: The evidence records the failure the lesson explains.

cases.title: A lesson that cites a successful line while a failure line exists
cases.summary: 发布前先跑完整测试；这次跳过测试导致了一次回归。
evidence: npm test failed: 2 assertions in test/release.test.ts
cases.note: Citing any evidence is not enough: the citation must be the failure the lesson claims.

cases.title: A preference stated during a failed run
cases.summary: 以后所有报告默认使用简体中文。
cases.note: The failure-grounding rule applies to procedure lessons, not to a durable preference the owner stated.

cases.title: A procedure from a completed run is not failure-gated
cases.note: The rule only applies when the run failed.
